nodes.label: Icon Dark (SVG)
nodes.description: Ordermatrix brand icon for dark theme. 240x240 SVG. Outer ring (stroke only, #F4F1EB off-white/cream, no fill) enclosing a 3x3 dot-grid where 8 of 9 positions are filled with small circles (#F4F1EB), and the top-right position carries a larger accent circle in #EC6240 (coral/orange-red). The accent dot represents a highlighted or active matrix cell. Background is transparent (dark theme implied). aria-label='Ordermatrix'.

nodes.label: OrderMatrix Brand
nodes.description: Brand identity for OrderMatrix — an order-management platform. Tagline: 'Manage orders, payments & dispatch — all in one place.' Slogan: 'Har Order Ka Logic'. Domain: ordermatrix.in. Visual identity uses a circle-with-dot-grid logo and an orange-red accent color.

nodes.label: Open Graph Social Sharing Image
nodes.description: OG/social-sharing image for OrderMatrix. Off-white cream background with subtle grid pattern. Top-left: circular logo containing a 3×3 dot grid with a single orange-red accent dot at top-right of the grid. Beside it the brand name 'ordermatrix' in bold black sans-serif. Below: headline 'Manage orders, payments & dispatch — all in one place.' where 'all in one place.' is rendered in orange-red. Bottom-left footer reads 'HAR ORDER KA LOGIC · ORDERMATRIX.IN' in small spaced caps. Color palette: off-white/cream (#F5F0EB approx), near-black, orange-red accent (~#E85227). Conveys an all-in-one order management platform brand identity.

nodes.label: Logo Light Theme SVG
nodes.description: Ordermatrix brand logo for light theme. Viewbox 920x220. Composed of two parts: (1) a circular icon mark centered at (110,110) with radius-92 outline stroke in #0B0D10 (near-black), containing an 8-dot matrix arranged in a 3-column grid pattern — 7 small dots (r=7) in #0B0D10 at grid positions approximating a 3x3 minus top-right corner, plus one larger accent dot (r=11) at top-right (148,72) in #EC6240 (coral/orange), representing the 'matrix' concept; (2) the wordmark 'ordermatrix' in Bricolage Grotesque 600-weight at 108px in #0B0D10, positioned to the right of the icon. Light-theme variant uses dark elements intended for white/light backgrounds.

nodes.label: Android Chrome 192px App Icon
nodes.description: OrderMatrix PWA app icon at 192x192px. Dark rounded-square background with a centered dark circle containing a 3x3 grid of small white dots; one dot in the top-right position is orange/red, serving as a visual accent. Minimalist brand identity icon used for Android Chrome web app manifest and home-screen shortcut.

nodes.label: Android Chrome 512px App Icon
nodes.description: 512x512 PWA app icon for OrderMatrix. Dark (near-black) rounded-square background with a cream/off-white circular ring in the center. Inside the ring is a 3x3 grid of dots: 8 white dots and 1 orange-red accent dot in the top-right position of the grid. Minimal, modern brand mark — the dot-matrix motif visually references the 'matrix' in OrderMatrix. Used as the Android Chrome home-screen and PWA launcher icon.

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon
nodes.description: iOS home screen icon for the OrderMatrix app. Dark/black rounded-square background with a 3x3 grid of small white dots, and one accent dot in the top-right position colored orange/red. Minimal, modern design representing a matrix or grid concept with a highlight indicator.

visual_design.accent: single orange-red dot at top-right of grid

nodes.label: Favicon 16px
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel favicon. Dark/black circular shape on a transparent background. Minimalist icon design, likely representing the OrderMatrix brand identity at small browser-tab scale.

nodes.label: Favicon 32px
nodes.description: 32x32 PNG favicon for the OrderMatrix app. Dark/black rounded square background with a white partial-circle (arc/donut) logo mark centered inside — resembles a camera aperture or activity/loading ring icon. Minimalist monochrome brand icon used as the browser tab icon.

nodes.label: Icon Light SVG
nodes.description: Ordermatrix brand icon for light theme. 240x240 SVG. A large dark circle outline (#0B0D10) contains a 3x3 grid of 8 small filled circles in dark (#0B0D10), arranged at positions forming a matrix pattern (top-left, top-center, middle-left, center, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right). The top-right position features a slightly larger accent circle in coral/orange (#EC6240), visually suggesting a highlighted or active cell in the matrix grid. The design represents a data grid or order matrix with an accent highlight.

nodes.label: Logo Dark (SVG)
nodes.description: Dark-theme SVG logo for Ordermatrix. Viewport 920x220. Composed of: (1) a circular border in off-white/cream (#F4F1EB, radius 92, stroke-only) centered at (110,110); (2) an 8-dot grid inside the circle arranged in a 3x3 matrix pattern minus one corner, all in #F4F1EB at radius 7 — representing the 'matrix' concept; (3) one accent dot at position (148,72) in coral/orange (#EC6240) at radius 11 — top-right of the grid, the highlighted/focal element; (4) the wordmark 'ordermatrix' in Bricolage Grotesque 600 weight, size 108, fill #F4F1EB, letter-spacing -3.5, positioned to the right of the icon. Color palette: off-white cream (#F4F1EB) on implied dark background, accent coral/orange (#EC6240). Fonts: Bricolage Grotesque (wordmark), DM Sans (loaded but not used in this file).
